characters.name: Foster Mother
characters.description: The foster mother is depicted as a beautiful lady with an ethereal presence. She has striking, elegant features and wears splendid, exquisite clothing that suggests nobility or celestial origins. Her demeanor is kind and gentle, exuding a warm, maternal aura. In the final revelation, she is revealed to be the Virgin Mary.

characters.name: Fosterdatteren
characters.description: The foster daughter is a young girl initially described as a very beautiful but poor child. She becomes increasingly lovely, ultimately becoming the 'aller vakreste.' Physically, she has fair skin and enchanting features, with expressive eyes that convey emotions despite her speechlessness. Her attire is simple but clean, reflecting modest beauty. In the forest, she's seen wearing a tunic and climbing a tree, her hair cascading down in loose waves, emphasizing her grace.

characters.name: Prinsen
characters.description: The prince is a handsome and noble young man, dressed richly in princely garments reflecting his royal status. He has a curious and discerning gaze, and a kind, determined expression, especially when he encounters the foster daughter. He's shown with a cloak and an ornate sword, embodying his role as a protector and capable royal figure.

characters.name: Fosterbarnet
characters.description: The first foster child is a baby taken by the foster mother, and the toddler boy who is seen later being returned. He has cherubic features, with rosy cheeks and wide inquisitive blue eyes, symbolizing innocence and purity.

characters.name: Second Foster Child
characters.description: The second foster child is also taken by the foster mother and reappears as a toddler, with curly light hair and playful demeanor, wearing simple linens that befit a young noble child spending time in nature.

characters.name: Eldste Barnet
characters.description: The oldest of the returned children, probably around 5-6 years old. This child mirrors the beauty of the foster mother, with flowing hair and a serene yet playful expression. Dressed in slightly more elaborate clothing compared to the younger siblings, possibly indicating a future of responsibility.
